name: Aljan
summary: Newcastle dialup/ISDN + hosting ISP from 1997; aljan.com.au taken over by NRU Internet (Newcastle) by 2000, later an Aussiewide page, parked by 2004 (AJM SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 076 512 064).

events.details: Newcastle NSW dialup/ISDN + hosting ISP ('Welcome to Aljan.Net Newcastle'); earliest Wayback capture 9 Feb 1997. AJM Services Pty Ltd, ACN 076 512 064.
Aljan brand wound down c.2000: by Feb 2000 aljan.com.au served NRU Internet (Newcastle) content, then an Aussiewide Internet / Femtech page (Mar 2003); domain parked with no service by Jun 2004.
